verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Xero has invoicing, invoice tracking (open/paid status), and contact/customer management (xero-docs-29, xero-docs-19, xero-docs-13), which are prerequisites for AR tracking, but there is no explicit mention of an aging report or per-customer balance report in the pack. missing for 10: explicit aging report feature documentation, per-customer outstanding balance report, independent/hands-on confirmation of AR reporting.
